name: qsketch
description: Mark up a screenshot in a Paint-style editor and attach it to your next message, so Claude sees exactly what you mean.

keepDays.title: Keep attachments for (days)
keepDays.description: Attached images are deleted after this many days. 0 keeps them forever. Use Save in the editor to keep a copy anywhere you like.

browser.title: Editor window
browser.description: Which browser opens the editor window: auto tries Edge, then Chrome, then your default browser.

showButton.title: Show the qsketch button above the prompt
showButton.description: When off, open the editor with /qsk. Pending attachments are always shown.
